Mammoth Ring equipped, or Ice Mammoth chests farmed with all daily keys. It drops from Ice Mammoth chests (about 1 in 10).
Thorium weapon in use: crafted and enhanced to within 1 step of your steel weapon (IX against a steel X), a common threshold that raises weapon attack for every class.
Thorium armor in use: all four pieces crafted and enhanced to III or more, which is where they overtake iron at VII.
Thorium set enhanced further, weapon first and then armor, to about 1,300 physical defence, the Act 2 guide's target for Maevath.
Nordic Amulet equipped, or Jotunn chests farmed with all daily keys. It drops from Jotunn chests (about 1 in 20).
Sunstone weapon in use: crafted and enhanced to within 2 to 4 steps of your thorium weapon.
Sunstone armor in use: crafted and enhanced to within 7 steps of your thorium armor.
Infinite 1 armor crafted from Act 1 Hard materials (Grassy Stone 1) and worn with the Sunstone weapon.
Anomalous Ring obtained from Choissiadyr, the second Act 3 boss.
Infinite 2 set crafted. Each piece consumes the matching Sunstone and Infinite 1 pieces plus Nightmare materials, and needs the Engineer Sun Scroll recipes.

tables.title: Gear rules
rows: When a new tier pays off

Enhancing adds the same flat amount per step on every tier, so a fresh item of the next tier is weaker than a well-enhanced old one. For thorium weapons, use within 1 step of steel as the common attack threshold: the base attack gains are 39 for longswords, 40 for bows and 57 for staves (75 for a thorium sword against a steel longsword), against 27.5 per enhancement step. Thorium armor equals iron about 5 steps higher, and sunstone armor equals thorium 8 steps higher. That is why the tiers say in use, not crafted.
Weapons are per class: sword or longsword for the Warrior, bow for the Rogue, staff for the Mage. Armor is shared by all classes.
Weapons and armor enhance up to XV. Each step adds 27.5 attack to a weapon and 5 defence to an armor piece. 'Within N steps of X' means at least X's enhancement level minus N.

Enhance Stone 1 drops from Act 1 bosses, Enhance Stone 2 from Act 2 bosses, and Enhance Stone 3 only from Zhai Halud's Gate. Hard and Nightmare bosses drop Grassy Enhance Stone 1 in Act 1 and Icy Enhance Stone 1 in Act 2. Infinite Enhance Stone II is crafted at the Infinite smith (recipe: 100 Sunstone Bars, 1,000 Grassy Stone II and 1 Enhance Stone 2).

The steel armor set gives 43 defence a piece against iron's 36, +10% combat XP each, and set bonuses since the May 14 update; the set bonus value is not in the wiki data (unverified until checked in game). The guides skip it and go from enhanced iron straight to thorium; craft it if you want the XP or the set bonus.
The thorium axe needs 10 Mammoth Bitusks and the thorium pickaxe 10 Jotunn Eyes, so tools come as each boss dies. For combat gear, enhance the weapon before the armor.
The boss rings, amulets and belts also gain attack as they are upgraded: 30 per step for up to 5 steps in the wiki data. Their other bonuses are fixed.
Event belts are the main source of shorter monster respawn, which raises the kill cap.
The Harvest event runs until 2 December 2026. If you have no event belt, check its shop: the Harvest Belt was in the 2025 Harvest event shop, and whether this year's shop has it is unverified.
They come from boss drops, each act's vendor, quests and login bonuses. Buy out the vendors daily.
Enhancing the steel weapon to X also earns a 30-gem achievement.
Weapons and armor can be enhanced down to 0 durability without breaking; 0 only blocks further attempts until repaired.
Amulets, rings and belts need a duplicate, and a failed attempt destroys both. Max is V. Always enhance the spare, never your only copy.

Fail on purpose on a junk item to build bonus chance, then switch to the real item; the failure counter is shared by all items. The usual junk item is the Essence Sword, taken to where its success chance is 10% and repaired with copies of itself. Bone Daggers (from the Act 1 vendor's Animal Bone) are the cheap alternative.
Event equipment uses Enhance Stone 1 and goes up to XV.
Pass old sets to alts. Do not spend scarce materials enhancing alt gear early.
Swords hit harder and suit bosses; longswords have the area damage for farming.

Copper, bronze, iron, steel (Act 1), thorium (Act 2), sunstone (Act 3), then Infinite 1 and Infinite 2 on the Hard tab. Steel has a full armor set and a belt as well as weapons. There is no Infinite 3 in the game data.
Sunstone has more damage and armor; Infinite 1 carries Drop Quantity. Start with Infinite 1 armor plus a Sunstone weapon. You need both sets in the end to craft Infinite 2.

Unlocked by the Sun Scroll upgrades Infinite II Armor (400 Sun Scroll) and Infinite II Weapons (600 Sun Scroll). A #guides thread warns that crafting it affects the enhancements on the pieces used; read it before crafting.
Crimson Geode and Crimson Sap drop at 1 in 200,000 from mining and woodcutting.
Since 0.321.0 there is a trinket slot as well; see the Trinkets page.
